entities.name: Alice Bunker Stockham
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alice Bunker Stockham was an American obstetrician and gynecologist who was the fifth woman to become a doctor in the United States. She promoted gender equality, dress reform, birth control, and male and female sexual fulfillment for successful marriages.
